project_summary: Lean storefront where notifications were a thin email-only afterthought

components.name: Real-time notifications delivery service
components.description: Transactional email notifications on order events via a single provider (SendGrid). No push, no SMS, no retry/queue: fire-and-forget from the order service.

components.name: Payment reconciliation job
components.description: Nightly batch matching Stripe payouts against orders. Single currency, single processor, CSV export.

project_summary: Regulated fintech where notifications were a multi-channel delivery platform

components.name: Real-time notifications delivery service
components.description: Multi-channel delivery (push, email, SMS) with a durable queue, per-channel retry/backoff, delivery receipts, user preferences and an audit trail for regulated events.

components.name: Payment reconciliation job
components.description: Real-time reconciliation across multiple processors and currencies, double-entry ledger, dispute handling and a regulator-facing report.
